description: All emails are plain text today. Add HTML formatting (multipart with plain text fallback). Create a shared Jinja template or helper for consistent styling across digest / alert / sync-failure / month-end. Email HTML needs inline CSS since most clients strip style tags. Scope: simple structure (headers, color-coded percentage spans, muted body text), not a design showpiece. Blocker for digest + month-end enrichment to feel polished.
title: HTML email formatting with shared template
